title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2026
summary: Our full autumn list, with meeting slots open from September.
body: Two years after our first stand in 2024, Epsilon Publishing Group returns to Frankfurt for a third year — this time at Hall 5.1, Stand C20. Pelin Yılmaz and Merve Sarıhan will be on site across all five days for rights meetings.
